summary: Li Auto Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its 2026 interim report, as required under Hong Kong Stock Exchange Rule 13.48(1) for the six months ending December 31, 2026. The filing is a routine periodic disclosure by a foreign private issuer and contains no special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, restructuring, or management change. No deal terms, board recommendations, or advisors are mentioned. This is a standard interim report submission with no actionable corporate action for investors.
